entry.author: Taupo District Council
entry.summary:
A rating valuation is an assessment of a property's value at a specific point in time. This assessment considers recent sales in your area, property characteristics, and local market trends. Revaluations are carried out every three years and are used to help us calculate what your share of rates will be.

New property valuations for the Taupō District were emailed and posted to property owners in May 2026, with an effective date of 1 September 2025.
